ssh_server.description: IP address or URL of the remote SSH server (required for token add)

ssh_user.description: Username used to connect to the SSH server

ssh_keypath.description: Path to the SSH private key used for authentication

ssh_path.description: Path to the key file on the remote server containing the passphrase

key_slot.description: Keyslot number to assign the token to (if omitted, first matching keyslot is used)

verbose.description: Enable verbose output (more detailed error messages)

debug_json.description: Enable debug output including JSON metadata
